learning_outcomes.text: Students can recognize the hydraulic and pneumatic symbols
students can understand working of hydraulic and pneumatic systems
They can find the reasons of problems of hydraulic and pneaumatic systems and can repair
They can explain to the operators the attention matters

syllabus_topics: Uses of hydraulic and pneumatic systems, advantges and disadvantages, basic concepts
Basic principles (pressure, load, flow, pascal law)
explaining Hydraulic pneumatic circuits, pressure and load, pressures of static and dynamic systems
Pumps, designs, working systems, pump test
Relief valves, Pressure dropping valves, designs and working systems, pressure setting
setting of the pressure control valves
Filters, filtration methods, tests of pollution, damages of the pollution
compressors, setup of the pressure air
hydraulic and pneumatic pipes, setting up of the pipes in circuits
Accumulators, types, designs, safety of the hydraulic and pneumatic systems, attention matters of the operators
